verdict.rationale: Lever's AI features page describes two in-product capabilities that generate insights from customer data. Talent Fit uses AI matching to surface high-potential candidates, and AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries turn interview data into actionable recaps. Both claims come only from marketing pages, and the benchmarking 'insights' on the analytics page are not described as AI-generated. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the AI insights work, AI-driven insights within analytics/dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration.
